title: Response Deadline and Extension Schedule — Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
This schedule sets, for each request type of the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product at Riverbend Regional Health, the number of calendar days HIM has to act on a request, the length and number of extensions, and two standing settings that apply to the deadline.

## Schedule

Column meanings:

- **Action deadline**: the number of calendar days after the request's received date within which Riverbend must act on the request.
- **Extension length**: the number of calendar days of the single extension.
- **Extensions allowed**: the number of extensions allowed per request.
- **Extension notice within the initial period**: whether the written extension notice (reason and new date) must be sent before the initial deadline.
- **Change of scope restarts the deadline**: whether a requester's change of scope after receipt restarts the action deadline.

| Request type | Action deadline (calendar days) | Extension length (calendar days) | Extensions allowed | Extension notice within the initial period | Change of scope restarts the deadline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | 30 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | 30 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | 30 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | 30 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | 30 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | 60 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | 60 | 30 | 1 | Yes | No |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Two action deadlines appear in the schedule: 30 calendar days for the five access and release request types, and 60 calendar days for the Amendment of Health Record Request and the Accounting of Disclosures Request.
2. The extension is the same on every request type: one extension of 30 calendar days.
3. Under each request type, a change of scope by the requester after receipt leaves the action deadline where it was.

## Reading the schedule on hypothetical figures

- A hypothetical Patient Access - Paper Copy request has an action deadline of 30 calendar days after its received date and may be extended once, by 30 calendar days; a second extension is not available because the schedule allows 1.
- A hypothetical Accounting of Disclosures Request has an action deadline of 60 calendar days after its received date, with the same single 30-day extension.
